details.s: Nimloth was an Elf of Doriath during the First Age. She was the daughter of Galathil, son of Galadhon, the son of Elmo. Elmo was the brother of Olwë and Elwë, making her a kinswoman of King Thingol.
f: Sindar (House of Elmo), Elves of Doriath
Unknown, possibly sometime during the Years of the Trees
